verdict.label: Light review
verdict.summary: Create a Slack app via the app settings, configure your OAuth redirect URI and scopes, and exchange tokens using the OAuth flow.

composioFit.summary: Composio provides a managed OAuth app for Slack, meaning you can test immediately without registering your own app.
whyOwnApp: You need your app name and branding on OAuth consent screens.
Your product requires custom scopes not included in Composio defaults.
You are hitting shared rate limits and need a dedicated quota.

phases.name: Create Slack App
steps: Go to the Slack API app settings page.
Create a new app and configure basic information.
phases.handoff: Copy your Client ID and Client Secret from the app settings.

phases.name: Configure Redirect URIs and Scopes
steps: Navigate to OAuth & Permissions in your app settings.
Add your redirect URI, ensuring it uses HTTPS.
Select and add your required bot or user scopes.
phases.handoff: Provide the Client ID, Client Secret, and Redirect URI to your configuration.

phases.name: Test OAuth Flow
steps: Redirect users to https://slack.com/oauth/v2/authorize with your client_id and scopes.
Approve the scopes in your test workspace.
Exchange the temporary authorization code for an access token via oauth.v2.access.
phases.handoff: Verify that your access token is successfully stored and can call Slack Web API methods.

artefacts.title: Scope Justification
artefacts.body: We request incoming-webhook and commands scopes to enable our AI agent to send messages and respond to user interactions seamlessly within approved Slack workspaces.

requirements.label: Privacy Policy URL
requirements.when: Required when distributing your app publicly through the Slack Marketplace.

scopes.purpose: Allows posting messages to specific channels via incoming webhooks.
Allows your app to handle slash commands.
Allows searching messages and files in Slack on behalf of a user.

redirectRules.rule: Your redirect_uri must match or be a subdirectory of a Redirect URL configured under App Management.
A Redirect URL can not contain an anchor (#).

blockers.cause: The redirect_uri parameter sent in the Authorize and Access steps does not match, or does not match the configured Redirect URL under App Management.
blockers.fix: Ensure the redirect_uri parameter value is identical across both steps and matches your app settings.
blockers.fallback: Remove extra redirect URLs or hardcode a single valid redirect URI in both app settings and code requests.

checklist.text: Create a new Slack app via the App Management settings.
Configure an HTTPS redirect URI under OAuth & Permissions.
Add required bot scopes (e.g., incoming-webhook, commands) and user scopes.
Copy Client ID and Client Secret into your auth configuration.
Test the OAuth redirect URL flow in your browser or test workspace.
Exchange the returned authorization code via POST to get an access token.

uncertainties: Exact enterprise app approval processing times are not documented with concrete durations.
Exact token expiration and refresh token rotation intervals for Slack OAuth tokens require checking token documentation details.

claims.text: Developers can obtain their first token quickly by following the OAuth redirect and access token exchange steps.
claims.quote: Your app obtains an access token in three steps: Waiting for a user to approve your requested scopes . Exchanging a temporary authorization code for an access token .
